# TOPO — TRAVEL PASSPORT 03 | BLANK FOLIO MASTER
## Production art prompt — FIRST artwork gate
**Status: prompt approved for owner review; no image generated by this Git commit.**
**Companion:** [Five-spread / ten-page contract](PASSPORT_FIVE_SPREADS_V2_SPEC_2026-10-26.md).
**References required:** previously owner-approved `TOPO TRAVEL PASSPORT 01 — CLOSED COVER`, `02 — OPEN BOOK`, original Nino interface benchmark. Do not use unrelated generic stock/leather-book visuals.

### Exact image request
Make **precisely one separate clean portrait page asset**, an empty right/left reusable folio sheet for Topo / Nino's physical Italian travel passport. This is a **blank asset**, not a composited UI mockup or a prefilled passport.

- Portrait sheet 3:4 ratio, ideally 1536 × 2048 px or greater.
- One full parchment page, centered, full visible outer silhouette and all corners, modest transparent margin **outside the page only**. The paper surface is deliberately fully opaque warm ivory/cream; no holes, checkers or artificially transparent pale areas **inside** the paper. No table, desk, hand, book spread or environment.
- Paper is thick archival Italian travel-journal stock: warm cream, subtle fibre, soft olive/sand underprint, elegant gentle aging at **edges only**, restrained small mottling and fine tactile grain, premium friendly 3D-illustration/bookbinding style. Not photoreal grunge.
- A thin understated vintage border/double hairline on the page's outer margins, extremely pale sepia. Few tiny ornamental botanical/compass marks at the outer corners at low opacity, optional; most of the page must be empty clean reading space.
- Delicate natural darkening near the inner binding edge **only lightly and neutral in the master**; do not lock a left/right spine-shadow direction into the master, because the app mirrors/places the same sheet on either side. Proper hinge, gutter, spine and page-turn shadows are separate book-shell/CSS elements.
- Broad safe margins: reserve at least 10–12% width and 8% height unprinted for actual UI content. Keep **approximately 80% central paper clear** for dynamic content. The beige/cream hue must match the previously approved open book.
- No fixed heading, title, personal name, page number, stamp slot, stamp impression, seal, sticker, postcard, photo, pizza, scooter, Nino, map, icon, state, arrows or button. No baked text whatsoever.
- No heavy centre gradient, noisy stains, bright gold, rounded app-card look, modern tablet UI, glossy emboss or close-up macro shadow.

### Why one page, not five fixed backgrounds
This single unfilled sheet is reused as a **real blank folio for ten interior pages**. Codex applies typed headings, 11 earned stamp slots, chapter Gold overlays, postcards and ARRIVO on separate accessible layers, instead of painting impossible earned states into the base art.

The **approved burgundy closed cover** remains unchanged and the approved open-book master is the reference for book geometry and palette. Do not redesign the cover, alter Nino identity or add a different passport book.

### Delivery gate / image QA
Produce exactly **one PNG source** (true transparency outside paper). Desired file `passport-blank-folio.png`, proposed future repo path `assets/nino/travel-passport/book/masters/passport-blank-folio.png`. Do not assert an exact pixel dimension or alpha until the delivered file is inspected.

Check it visibly paired twice in a **separate app/layout QA composite**, not baked into the source, next to the approved original cover/book. Test at iPad landscape 2-page and portrait 1-page. Note whether grain is calm enough below stamps, labels and up to 200% text, and whether the paper can support six stamp positions across spread2 without clipping. Reject fake baked blank stamp rings or art references that drift from the established cream/burgundy identity.

### Mandatory quality bars
- Source is a reusable production layer, not a pretty flattened five-spread illustration.
- The paper itself is naturally opaque; **only external canvas area transparent**.
- Cream parchment avoids fake sticker effect (actual stamps later require transparent *ink only*).
- Single-sheet source has no fixed direction-specific cast shadow and no false earned items.
- Warm Italian, inviting, premium; not an old government identity document.
